hook: This is the most famous vampire castle in the world. But no vampire ever lived here. Not even Dracula.
built: Bran Castle was built by Saxon townspeople from Brasov, and finished in 1388, as a customs post on a mountain pass.
vlad: Vlad the Impaler, the real man behind Dracula? Most historians say he never set foot inside. His own fortress was Poenari, far away in Wallachia.
stoker: And Bram Stoker, who wrote Dracula in 1897, never visited Romania. His novel doesn't even mention Bran.
queen: The real story is sweeter. In 1920, the people of Brasov gave the castle to Queen Marie of Romania. It became one of her favourite homes.
museum: The communists seized it in 1948. It was returned to her family in 2006, and today it's a museum.
end: So it's not a vampire's lair. It's a queen's home. Would you still visit at night?
